issues: Scores before: creativity 6, typography 6, layout & rhythm 4, polish 4, brand-colour robustness 6, mobile 5, generic-template feel 5.

The featured products (the whole point of 'product-as-hero') stayed invisible: the .rv reveal depended only on IntersectionObserver, so the right column showed huge blank 68svh slabs on desktop and mobile.

Hero title 'bleed' pushed the first line into the stage image with mix-blend-mode:difference. 'Take a ride,' and 'Een levenslange herinnering,' looked misaligned and garbled, like a layout bug rather than a choice.
The multi-line accent highlight (.mark) was a block with fit-content, so with long brand copy (Birth Bear) one flat slab sat behind the last line instead of a per-line marker.
Outside the sticky viewport the left half of the theatre was an empty flat void, which made the page read as half-empty.
Stage caption was a timid pill in the corner. 'Big prices' were not big on the stage itself.
Products without a price (Birth Bear) collapsed to a small name plus a button, an empty-looking act.
Mobile lost the signature wipe entirely; stacked images just appeared.
fixed: Added a reveal safety net (all .rv content shown after 2.6s) on both pages, so products, stats and story can never stay invisible.

Removed the broken bleed/difference effect. The hero title is now a clean, balanced display setting (text-wrap:balance, slightly tighter clamp), and .mark is inline with box-decoration-break so the brand-colour highlight follows each line.

Gave the theatre's left column a 'backstage' surface (brand tint plus 16-column brand-colour rules echoing the curtain stripes), so the split always reads as a deliberate stage, whatever the brand colour.
Rebuilt the stage caption: bottom-left, elevated card, tracked uppercase label, price at up to 5rem. Big price, small details, right on the hero image.
Price-less products switch to a giant display-sized name, so the act still has a hero line.
Brought the signature wipe to mobile: product and story images reveal with a clip-path curtain plus scale settle as they enter view.
